verifiable-quality-gates.why: each of the five consumer-install fixes ships a discrimination test that fails when the fix is reverted (arch-gate still catches product code while skipping the anchored vendored path; reference-links skips citers yet keeps targets and still flags an outside dangling link; the discriminate script distinguishes a missing fixture from a gate miss; the consumer manifest names no uninstalled machinery test)
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added ISSUE-142/#118/#126/#128 discrimination tests and the #117 three-way resolution test, each exercising the real gate/script
quotes: test must FAIL when the check is replaced by a no-op

architectural-decision-records.why: the install-breaker cluster (why arch-gate and reference-links skip the vendored tree, the anchored-ignore anti-evasion, the fixture/manifest honesty) is architecturally significant and recorded in one ADR with the change
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR-0072 covering all five fixes, the anchoring/anti-evasion rationale, and the honest limit that the CI harness is the follow-on
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: each fix is pinned at the level that owns it, a gate/script integration test that runs the real gate against a fixture, matching the risk (a false-green or install-breaking gate)
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: integration tests that spawn the real arch-gate / reference-links / discriminate / esk-genesis against throwaway fixtures and assert exit codes
quotes: Test at the lowest level that can catch the bug, and match the test type to the risk.

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: the non-happy paths were enumerated and committed as executable cases: a vendored violation skipped vs product code caught, a dangling link inside vs outside the ignored tree, a missing fixture, and a machinery entry with no test
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: added those scenarios as node:test cases across the four gate test files
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment.

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR states the honest limit (these fixes make a vendoring consumer pass; the end-to-end proof is the CI harness landing next), and each fix's detection claim is backed by a re-runnable discrimination test
skeptical-audit.what: recorded the limit in ADR-0072 and verified each fix against existing and new tests (702 pass, 0 fail)
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

judge-arch.why: a fresh-context review was run on the change before the PR, with explicit scrutiny of the anti-evasion property (anchored, provenance-locked ignores) and the manifest sha correctness
judge-arch.what: ran judge-arch in a fresh subagent over the gate scripts, the manifest, and the tests; recorded in the arch-review log
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: no input, auth, session, crypto, upload or dependency surface changed; the new ignores are ANCHORED (a decoy src/.claude/skills is still scanned) and the invoke is provenance/parity-locked, so the gates' existing anti-evasion property is preserved, not weakened

pattern-selector.why: no new feature, class, module or data flow; the fixes reuse the existing anchored-ignore and three-way-resolution patterns already used by the other gates

arch-encode.why: each fix is enforced by a discrimination test, not a new rules-file entry; the broader prevent-by-construction rule is the CI harness in the next change

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no PII, retention, migration, backup or audit logic; this is gate scanning scope and installer manifest shape

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no system, service, database or integration architecture changed; this adjusts gate scan scope and the consumer manifest

release-deployment-safety.why: no deploy, migration, feature-flag or rollback mechanism changed; the version bump and release are standard provenance-bound library versioning

sre-operational-readiness.why: no SLI/SLO, alert, runbook or production-operability surface changed

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: no user-facing or UI surface; this is developer-facing gate tooling

universal-browser-device-support.why: no frontend or browser-facing code; this is developer-facing gate tooling

usability-ux-universal-design.why: no user-facing flow, screen, form or copy; this is developer-facing gate tooling
